newsitem.title: USA: Rochester County, N.Y., sells $63.3 mln of BANs.
newsitem.headline: Rochester County, N.Y., sells $63.3 mln of BANs.

text.p: Rochester County, N.Y., said Wednesday it sold $63.3 million of bond anticipation notes (BANs) to five firms in a competitive auction.
Merrill Lynch & Co won the bulk of the notes with $25 million at a net interest cost (NIC) of 3.8145 percent and a coupon of 4.50 percent.
Fleet Securities won $15 million with an NIC of 3.826 percent and a coupon of 4.25 percent.
Prudential Securities said it won $10 million of notes with an NIC of 3.828 percent and a coupon of 4.25 percent.
BT Securities said it won $9.347 million with an NIC of 3.82887 percent and a coupon of 4.50 percent.
And Citicorp Securities said it won $4 million with an NIC of 3.787 percent and 4.25 percent.
